name: hear_world_investigate
about: An ambient_generic sound_event heard, investigated and walked back from (10a, 10e, 10k, 8). PlaySound -> CAmbientGeneric::InputPlaySound 0x101ad3e0 -> 0x101ad470 USE_ON: sound_event 2 (WORLD) with owner !player resolved by 0x101ad9a0 -> InsertSound(2, owner origin, VolumeLevels[3] = 1200, max(1, duration), not occludable, owner), once (senses.md 'ambient_generic as an AI sound source'). The neutral listener (D_NU 5, npc_perception 1 -> Inspection_Hearing_Scalars[1] = 0.71, Inspection_Vision_Distances[1] = 290) on north (384, 0) Source units hears it at 768 units (radius 0.71 x 1200 = 852; CanHearSound 0x1030f7b0); OnListened 0x1026a5e0 queues HEAR_WORLD 0x6e with RandomFloat(0.2, 0.9) and fires OnHearWorld with it. The sound sweep 0x102b1cd0 arm 1: HEAR_WORLD && ShouldInvestigate 0x102b3270 (investigate_mode 3: any player; the owner is the player) -> INVESTIGATE_SOUND 0x25, which IDLE_DISPOSITION interrupts on; SelectIdealState 0x102ad660 case 1 -> ALERT; SelectSchedule ALERT 0x102af8fa -> 0x102b9060: INVESTIGATE_SOUND + HEAR_WORLD -> SCHED_TROIKA_INVESTIGATE_SOUND (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_investigate_sound.sch: STOP_MOVING, STORE_LASTPOSITION, REMEMBER INVESTIGATING, ALERT_LOOK_AT_BEST_SOUND, WAIT_RANDOM 0.5, PLAY_SOUND, WAIT_RANDOM 1.5, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE 20, GET_PATH_TO_BESTSOUND, SET_NPC_FLAG IGNORE_DOOR_FAILURE, SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE, WALK_RUN_PATH_COMBAT_SOUND, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, SET_SCHEDULE SCHED_TROIKA_ALERT_LOOK_AROUND), then sched_troika_alert_look_around.sch (... WAIT 5 ... GET_PATH_TO_LASTPOSITION, WALK_PATH, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, FACE_LASTANGLE, CLEAR_LASTPOSITION, FORGET INVESTIGATING): back to the stored spot. The sound sits where the player stood at t = 2 (-384, 0); the player is then moved to corner_ne (384, 384), at least 384 units from every point of the listener's route, out of its 290-unit sight, so no SEE_PLAYER / SEE_SOUND_SOURCE interrupts the walk.
known_red: new: the sound is sometimes never heard -- no HEAR_WORLD in the 2.5 s after PlaySound in 3 boots of this record (an identical twin and two sibling records heard it at +0.45 s); the port's Listen drops a sound at its authored expiry (ElysiumNpcSenses.cpp:713, ExpireTime < Now) where retail's pool keeps it 4 s longer (CSoundEnt think 0x101ba890) and listens within ~0.3 s at 768 units
